job_description:
Join our Quality Assurance team as a Software QA Engineer focusing on test automation. Perfect for Computer Science graduates who love ensuring software quality and learning automation frameworks.

Key Duties:
- Develop and maintain automated test suites
- Design and execute test cases for web applications
- Perform API testing using Postman or similar tools
- Write automated tests using Python and Selenium
- Conduct manual testing when needed
- Report and track bugs in Jira
- Collaborate with developers to resolve issues
- Participate in sprint planning and retrospectives
- Improve QA processes and best practices

Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related field
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
- Basic programming knowledge (Python preferred)
- Understanding of software testing concepts
- Attention to detail and quality-focused mindset
- Good written and verbal communication
- Ability to work in an Agile environment
- Self-motivated and eager to learn

Preferred Skills:
- Experience with test automation tools (Selenium, Cypress)
- Knowledge of API testing
- Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines
- Understanding of SQL for database testing
- Exposure to performance testing
- Experience with version control (Git)

What We Provide:
- Salary range: $70,000 - $100,000
- Health, dental, and vision insurance
- 401k retirement plan
- Paid time off and holidays
- Professional development and training
- Career growth opportunities
- Hybrid work model (SF Bay Area)
- Collaborative team environment
- Modern testing tools and infrastructure
- Regular knowledge sharing sessions
